content:
Platforms: Windows, Public Cloud
This event provides key metadata regarding subnets configured in AWS. CrowdStrike retrieves this information by processing the response from AWS's
DescribeSubnets API [https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AWSEC2/latest/APIReference/API_DescribeSubnets.html] on your behalf. Subnets represent a level of
network segmentation and are created within a VPC to control and manage routing configurations.
This event is only generated for Discover for AWS [/support/documentation/10/falcon-discover-feature-guide] customers. It's generated either when Discover
for AWS observes new or related activity via CloudTrail or during Discover for AWS's weekly full scan.
